deadline.value: Apply by November 30, 2026 for Autumn 2027 entry (applications open September 15, 2026).

gre_subject.value: The Chemistry GRE Subject Test is optional.

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is optional.
gre_general.quote: official GRE scores (optional) | Per the statement above, all GREs are optional.

toefl_min.value: Chemistry requires TOEFL iBT 108 (tests before 21 Jan 2026) or 5.5 on the new scale, higher than the university minimum, unless you are exempt (e.g. an English-medium degree).
toefl_min.quote: Minimum TOEFL score for Chemistry Dept: 108 (taken before 1/21/26) / 5.5 (taken on or after 1/21/26)

ielts_min.value: Chemistry requires IELTS Academic 8 overall, unless you are exempt.
ielts_min.quote: Minimum IELTS score for Chemistry Dept: 8

supervisor.value: The admissions pages do not say you need a supervisor before applying; the statement of purpose should name research groups that interest you.

funding.value: All PhD students in good standing get full support (tuition plus salary or stipend); first-year students usually hold teaching assistantships.
funding.quote: Historically, all chemistry PhD students in good standing have received full financial support (tuition and salary or stipend) for the duration of their graduate studies at Stanford. | The University mandates five years of support for all PhD students in good academic standing.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) is enough; Chemistry has PhD admission only, no MS program.
entry_route.quote: You must hold, or expect to hold before enrollment at Stanford, a U.S. bachelor’s degree or its international equivalent from a college or university of recognized standing.

also.quote: Applications are accepted from candidates who intend to pursue the Ph.D. degree. We do not have a MS degree program.

notes: Department TOEFL/IELTS minimums (108 / 5.5 / IELTS 8) are higher than the university's. The FAQ also describes an English-test waiver request with an official English-medium statement for degrees from non-exempt countries.
